name: Aureboro
backstory: Child of Auroboro and Aurebalo; raised in Gorff on takes stonework commissions at the market each morning,..., and carries some knowledge of Birth Of Fenrius.

criterion.standard: measures a life by whether Gorff is still remembered rightly
criterion.wasted_life: forgetting what Gorff actually meant, the way most people already have
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: walks the tollhouse route once or twice a week, more curious about the old raid than either of his parents ever let on being

arc.premise: Aureboro wants to formalize a paid rotation of escorts for caravans along the transit route, using his standing at the tollhouse to line up drivers and guards willing to commit to a fixed schedule - fewer losses to bandits, and something concrete to show for the family's old claim on the road.
